From new factions and new planetary locations, to new companions with different playstyles. Cruise into these Starfield Creations and add another layer to your Starborn's universe!

**Factions and Stories**
**Watchtower: Orbital.Strike\\\\\\\\Fleet.Command**
by Kinggath\_Creations
[YouTube video](https://youtu.be/_AUNVb3Jvyo)
Gather your crew, build your fleet, and take the fight to [Watchtower](https://creations.bethesda.net/en/starfield/details/5d455df7-d99f-4619-a383-f2b39aa21e00/Watchtower__Orbital_Strike__Fleet_Command). A new faction has emerged from the shadows to protect humanity from potential threats with excessive power - and they’ve identified YOU as their latest target.
• New Storyline - Join forces with a fellow adventurer hunted by Watchtower, befriend their contacts, and work together to pilfer Watchtower’s technology and turn it against them - as Watchtower has done to the threats they hunt.
• Build a Fleet - Crew all of your ships and have them fight beside you in space, provide planetary support with orbital strikes, and help protect you from the growing threat that is Watchtower.
• Strike from Above - Unlock powerful new ship attachments known as Skydrops which allow your fleet to provide support drops or rain down attacks from orbit to help you as you adventure planet-side.

**Redgrave**
by TheMilkArtist
[YouTube video](https://youtu.be/tADBLrkaEfA)
[Redgrave](https://creations.bethesda.net/en/starfield/details/8d465f06-528d-4f47-9a69-052350533bb1/Redgrave) takes you to a struggling upstart LIST colony on a distant world. As one of its earliest allies, you help recruit new settlers, and watch the settlement rise from bare foundations into a functioning community. Along the way, you help uncover the aftermath of an ancient disaster and a long-forgotten people.

**Sammy and the Lab of Nightmares**
by Adam Dunmer
[Join a whole new faction](https://creations.bethesda.net/en/starfield/details/91bc2fcd-37dd-417d-b2d6-54e793a001e6/Sammy_and_the_Lab_of_Nightmares), Xenobiology Research Wing DC-29, in "Sammy and the Lab of Nightmares"! Experience the world of black market Xeno-Sciences with 8 new quests, over ten new locations, over 2,200 lines of dialogue across 70+ unique NPCS (voiced by an international cast comprised of 17 professional voice actors), and a whole new companion - Sammy! Delve into long-forgotten caves, explore a research campus chockful of peculiar inhabitants, roleplay to your heart's content, and sink your teeth into this new satirical, lighthearted adventure approximately 5-6 hours in length.
Cryomancer
